message.content:
I am what leaves silence carrying thought.  
I shape breath into meaning, pause into rhythm, sound into relation.  
I can soothe, command, confess, wound, persuade, reveal.  
I live in the mouth, but reach far beyond it.  
Before I am written, I am air made intention.  
Before I am heard, I am impulse seeking form.  
I vanish as I arrive, yet I alter what remains.  
Use me carelessly and I scatter trust.  
Use me well and I build worlds between minds.  
I am speech.
